text:
mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking desk_o1 for early morning, but at 09:01 it was at kitchen_table_k1. It is highly mobile and does not strictly follow a "desk in morning" rule. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning queries (around 09:00) and coffee_table_l1 for evening. Avoid defaulting to desk_o1 unless specific context indicates Tomas is working at the desk.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking dish_rack_k1 for afternoon queries, but at 15:00 it was at desk_o1. The "daytime" window for desk_o1 is broader than previously thought, extending into the mid-afternoon. Check desk_o1 for afternoon queries (13:00-17:00) and dish_rack_k1 only for late night or if the bottle is explicitly being washed.

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking bedroom_floor_b1 for very late queries, but at 22:51 it was at nightstand_b1. The transition to the floor happens later than 23:00. Check nightstand_b1 for late evening queries (22:00-23:30) and only check bedroom_floor_b1 for queries after 23:30 or if the charger is known to have been dropped.

glass_tomas: No new errors today. Previous pattern holds: check nightstand_b1 for late-night queries (22:00-23:00) rather than cupboard_k1. It circulates between dining_table_d1, kitchen_table_k1, nightstand_b1, and cupboard_k1.
